name: Prism Js syntax highlighter
description: CKEditor 5 plugin plus a reversible text-format filter that lets editors insert a code block, pick a language, and render it with PrismJS syntax highlighting.
project_description: Provides a CKEditor 5 plugin and a companion text-format filter that let content editors insert a source-code block, choose one of PrismJS's languages from a dialog, and have it rendered with PrismJS syntax highlighting on the published page. A toolbar button opens a dialog that stores the chosen language and code on a custom <prism-js> element (data-plugin-id / data-plugin-config); the 'Prism Js' filter later converts that element into PrismJS-ready <pre><code class="language-..."> markup and attaches the selected theme's assets. All PrismJS CSS/JS (eight bundled themes) ships locally with the module. A settings form at /admin/config/content/prism-js selects which of ~297 languages appear in the editor dialog and the default color theme. Depends on core ckeditor5.
